evidence.excerpt: We introduce SEABED, an audio-first question answering dataset designed to benchmark language and audio reasoning models on SEA speech.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Southeast Asia (SEA) is served instead by benchmarks that inherit an English task taxonomy of recognition, translation, and paralinguistic classification, and therefore test whether a model hears SEA speech rather than whether it can reason from it.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
